name: doc-harness
description: Document-based project control for AI-human collaboration. State is a projection from an append-only event log, so any agent can take over a long-running project from files alone — plus an optional deterministic toolbelt that makes the mechanical parts falsifiable.

plugins.name: doc-harness
plugins.description: Document-based project control (English). An append-only events.log is the primitive; CURRENT_STATUS.md (NOW + work surface) is a generated projection; guards catch drift, dead pointers, missing provenance and unrecorded work. Commands: /doc-harness init, check, sync, flush, recall, resume.

plugins.name: doc-harness-zh
plugins.description: 基于文档的项目控制系统（中文版）。以 append-only 的 events.log 为原语，CURRENT_STATUS.md（NOW + 活跃工作面）是由它生成的投影；配套守卫检查漂移、死指针、缺失溯源与未记录的工作。命令：/doc-harness init、check、sync、flush、recall、resume。
